subject: ela
intro: Read and pick how the facts connect.

items.prompt:
Read.

It was cold, so we put on coats.

Why did we put on coats?
A) We were hot
B) Because it was cold
C) It was sunny

steps: Cause and effect. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Read.

The dog was hungry, so it ate.

Why did the dog eat?
A) It was full
B) Because it was hungry
C) It was tired

Read.

First we mix. Then we bake.

What is first?
A) Bake
B) Mix
C) Eat

Read.

The plant got water and sun, so it grew tall.

Why did the plant grow?
A) It was cut
B) It got water and sun
C) It was cold
items.answer: B) It got water and sun

solution.answer: B) It got water and sun

items.prompt:

items.prompt:
Read.

The ice got warm, so it melted into water.

What connects 'warm' and 'melted'?
A) They are not connected
B) Warm caused the melting
C) Melting caused the warm

steps: Cause and effect. Key is B.
